canonical.name: Cohomological differential graded algebra over a commutative ring
canonical.detail: A Z-graded R-module over a commutative ring, with an associative unital degree-zero R-bilinear product, an R-linear degree-one cochain differential satisfying d^2=0, and the cohomological signed Leibniz rule; graded commutativity is not assumed.

canonical.name: Cohomological left and right differential graded modules
canonical.detail: Separate left/right unital graded module actions with degree-one square-zero differentials; left compatibility is d(am)=d(a)m+(-1)^|a|a d(m), and right compatibility is d(ma)=d(m)a+(-1)^|m|m d(a). A bimodule additionally uses commuting actions.

sources.title: The Stacks Project, Chapter 22: Differential Graded Algebra
sources.locator: Chapter 22, §§22.2–22.4 and 22.11; especially Definitions 22.3.1 and 22.4.1 and the left-module convention in §22.11

contents.argument: Cohomological and homological conventions, associative unital graded multiplication, degree-one differential, square-zero condition, and signed Leibniz rule.
Right- and left-module gradings, degree-one square-zero differentials, and the distinct signed compatibility formulas for right and left actions.

sources.title: Bernhard Keller, Introduction to A-infinity algebras and modules
sources.locator: §3.1, pp. 5–6 (PDF pages); strict dg case in the immediate consequences after the A-infinity identities

contents.argument: The first A-infinity operations identify a cochain differential and signed derivation; when all operations of arity at least three vanish, the structure is an associative dg algebra.

canonical.name: Polynomial differential forms on the line
canonical.detail: The graded algebra Z[t]⊕Z[t] epsilon, |t|=0, |epsilon|=1, epsilon^2=0 with d(f+g epsilon)=f' epsilon; the symbolic proof verifies the signed Leibniz rule and d^2=0.

canonical.name: A degree-one derivation need not square to zero
canonical.detail: On Q<x,u,v> with degrees 0,1,2 and delta(x)=u, delta(u)=v, delta(v)=0, the word extension is a degree-one graded derivation but delta^2(x)=v is nonzero.

canonical.name: A differential graded algebra as its regular left module
canonical.detail: For every cohomological DGA A, left multiplication and d_M=d_A make A a left differential graded module over itself.
